title: "Fourth Layer of the Tianji"
next_chapter_hook: "The fourth layer of the Tianji Record states: The chess game of fate is changing—and those eyes from Ling Yuan are still watching him from the shadows."

text.content: "The setting sun burns like blood, dyeing the main peak of the Tianqing Sect crimson. Chen Ji stood before the cave dwelling's entrance, his fingertips still retaining the warmth of battle's aftermath—the scalding气息 that escaped when the Tianji Record was unsealed, branding new patterns into his palm like a branding iron. Ling Yuan's gaze, those eyes that seemed capable of piercing through all things, still lingered unforgotten in his mind."

dialogue.content: "「Fourth layer... finally unlocked.」 Mo Xiansheng's voice drifted from between the yellowed pages, carrying an almost imperceptible sigh. 「Boy, do you know what this means?」"

text.content: "Chen Ji did not answer immediately. He slowly turned the pages of the Tianji Record, his gaze falling upon the yellowed sheets—where once the patterns had been blurred, they now appeared as clear as carved inscriptions, dense text writhing like living creatures, as if eager to divulge some long-buried secret to him. The moment the fourth layer unlocked, a torrent of information flooded into his Mental Sea like a deluge."

dialogue.content: "「The Tianji Record is not a creation of fortune.」 Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul manifested upon the pages, his expression more grave than ever before. 「It is one of the pieces placed in this world by the Eyes of Heavenly Way—tools used to select and cultivate seers. Every holder of the Tianji Record throughout history was once a candidate of its...」"

text.content: "Chen Ji's heart sank heavily. Selection? Cultivation? He suddenly recalled those seers who had vanished in the long river of history—they had shone like stars, yet ultimately all perished silently. At the time he had simply attributed it to heaven envying talent, but now he wondered... perhaps they all reached the end of some path, cruelly discarded by the Eyes of Heavenly Way."

dialogue.content: "「Indeed.」 As if seeing through his thoughts, Mo Xiansheng's remnant shadow trembled slightly. 「Every seer is a seed sown by the Eyes of Heavenly Way. It waits—waits for someone to walk far enough, perfect enough, and then...」 He paused. 「Harvests them.」"

text.content: "These two words fell like a basin of ice water over his head. Chen Ji's fingers holding the Tianji Record turned faintly white, his knuckles blanched from strain. He recalled his unmatched calculations in countless decisions, all those enemies he had manipulated—originally, from on high, another pair of eyes had watched all his efforts."

choice.prompt: "Faced with this shocking truth, Chen Ji must make a choice:"

choices.description: "Since he is a chess piece, there must be rules. And where there are rules, there are loopholes. Chen Ji decided to first digest this information and seek methods to counter the Eyes of Heavenly Way."
choices.visible_reward: "Gain key information: Heavenly Fate True Eye"
choices.risk_hint: "Needs time, but may discover hidden turning points"

text.content: "Chen Ji drew a deep breath, forcing himself to calm. He was the most outstanding strategist of the Tianqing Sect, never losing his composure in disadvantageous situations. 「Since I am a chess piece,」 he spoke slowly, 「then that means the chess game has rules. And where there are rules, there must certainly be flaws.」 Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul startled slightly, then let out a low laugh: 「You are far more level-headed than those before you.」"

choices.description: "Mo Xiansheng was Chen Xuan's guardian, but whose side was he truly on? Chen Ji decided to first clarify this critical issue."
choices.visible_reward: "Gain key information: Truth of the Fourth Layer"

text.content: "「Wait.」 Chen Ji suddenly raised his head, a sharp light flickering in his eyes. 「You are Chen Xuan's guardian, yet you guard within this Tianji Record telling me these things. Are you Chen Xuan's chess piece, or the Eyes of Heavenly Way's chess piece?」 Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul fell silent for a moment, his expression complex: 「This question... is a good one.」"

choices.text: "Act immediately, give enemies no time to react"
choices.description: "Since Ling Yuan was watching, Chen Ji decided to strike first. He would lay his next move before the enemy could even react."
choices.visible_cost: "Insufficient information organization, may miss key details"

text.content: "A cold, biting light flashed in Chen Ji's eyes. Ling Yuan's surveillance made him acutely aware of time's urgency—if the enemy had already made their move, he could not afford to wait passively. 「Whatever the Eyes of Heavenly Way is,」 he rose, his voice low but firm, 「I will not wait to be slaughtered.」"

"Mo Xiansheng gazed at Chen Ji, a flicker of approval in his eyes: 「Since you ask, I shall tell you. The fourth layer is special because it records how to break free from the control of the Eyes of Heavenly Way—but the prerequisite is that you must walk to its presence and personally accept the final trial.」 His voice dropped like night. 「The end of this volume will give you an answer.」"

dialogue.content: "「The Eyes of Heavenly Way is not some specific life form,」 Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul spoke slowly. 「It is a convergence of will, existing within the very source of heavenly way's operation. It has no concept of good or evil, only one purpose—to maintain fate's order. And seers... are its tools for correcting deviations.」"

text.content: "Chen Ji felt a suffocating pressure. He suddenly understood why those seers vanished one after another—not because they were not powerful enough, but because when they walked far enough, they were consumed by this formless will. The so-called 'inevitable backlash of fate' was from the beginning a rule pre-installed on the board."

dialogue.content: "「But you are different from the others.」 Mo Xiansheng shifted his tone, pointing to a line of small text at the end of the Tianji Record's fourth layer. 「Chen Xuan at the last moment found a loophole—he discovered that when two or more variables exist simultaneously in the chess game, the Eyes of Heavenly Way's attention becomes divided. This is the only possibility for resistance.」"

choice.prompt: "The new ability gave Chen Ji more choices:"

choices.text: "Immediately verify the practicality of the new ability"
choices.description: "Chen Ji decided to first test the ability he had just gained—see if anyone was still secretly watching."
choices.risk_hint: "May expose the existence of new ability"

text.content: "Chen Ji did not hesitate, immediately activating the Heavenly Fate True Eye. In an instant, countless fine silk-like rays appeared in his vision—those were threads of cause and effect, connecting all things in the world. Among these lines, he clearly saw three gazes extending toward this direction. One came from Ling Yuan, gloomy and dangerous; one from... the direction of the Eyes of Heavenly Way, vast and cold; the third unexpectedly—a warm light tinged with anxiety."

choices.text: "Dig deeper into the weaknesses of the Eyes of Heavenly Way"
choices.description: "Since it is a heavenly will, it follows rules of operation. Chen Ji decided to find more details from the fourth layer's information."
choices.visible_reward: "May discover key clues to reverse fate"

text.content: "Chen Ji steadied his mind and opened the Tianji Record's fourth layer once more. This time, he was not in a hurry for quick results, but studied those obscure words character by character. Among countless profound records, he finally found a key passage: 'The Eyes of Heavenly Way uses karma as threads and Heavenly Fate as guidance. It watches the chess game but cannot intervene in it—because intervention means variables, and variables are what it fears most.' A faint smile curved Chen Ji's lips."

choices.description: "One person's strength has limits after all. Chen Ji thought of several people he might trust—Su Qingyao, Ye Qing, even Han Lie."

text.content: "Chen Ji closed the book pages and began considering potential candidates. Su Qingyao... she was the most likely to trust him, but her identity was sensitive; Ye Qing... the Holy Sect's Saint Maiden, with whom he had a secret agreement, but behind her stood the entire Holy Sect; Han Lie... that simple-minded fellow, perhaps the simplest chess piece of all. Just as he weighed the pros and cons, the cave dwelling's barrier suddenly chimed—someone had arrived."

"Heavenly Fate True Eye—this was the entirely new ability the fourth layer of the Tianji Record granted Chen Ji. No longer passively glimpsing the future, but actively observing cause and effect. He could see the threads of karma on each person, see the butterfly effects of every choice, even perceive the flow of fate within a certain range. This was the first key to oppose the Eyes of Heavenly Way."

"「Remember,」 Mo Xiansheng's voice sounded again, 「though the Eyes of Heavenly Way is powerful, it is not invincible. It is bound by the rules of heavenly way's operation—when enough variables appear in fate's chess game, its attention becomes divided. And you...」 He gazed deeply at Chen Ji. 「You must become that greatest variable.」"

dialogue.content: "「There is one more thing.」 Mo Xiansheng's voice suddenly turned solemn. 「The final page of the fourth layer contains a prophecy—'When all nine layers of the Tianji Record are fully opened, the heavenly way's cycle shall restart.' Chen Xuan never reached that step; his Tianji Record at the seventh layer had its first two pages seized by Ling Yuan. Now...」 He looked at Chen Ji. 「This burden falls upon you.」"

choice.prompt: "Faced with this heavy burden, Chen Ji's choice is:"

choices.text: "Accept the mission, move forward bearing the weight"
choices.description: "Since fate brought him this far, Chen Ji chose to accept it with composure. He would let those who underestimated him know what true strategic perfection meant."
choices.visible_reward: "Gain Mo Xiansheng's complete trust and a new layer of inheritance"

text.content: "Chen Ji fell silent for a moment, then raised his head, his eyes shining with more determination than ever. 「I understand.」 He said softly. 「Since this is my fate, I will rewrite it with my own hands. From today onward, I am no longer a chess piece—I will be the one who overturns the board.」 Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul trembled slightly, and a warm force flowed from the pages, slowly infusing into Chen Ji's Brow Center—the final layer of inheritance left by Chen Xuan."

choices.memory_label: 陈机接受了命运的挑战

choices.description: "Aim high, but also stay grounded. Chen Ji decided to first use his new ability to solidify his advantages before planning further."
choices.risk_hint: "Enemy may take this chance to set up formations"

text.content: "「I accept this mission,」 Chen Ji said, 「but not now.」 He turned toward the depths of the cave dwelling and began setting new barriers. 「Since Ling Yuan has already moved, it means he knows something too. I need time—need to get the full measure of his capabilities, need to make my arrangements more thorough.」 Mo Xiansheng nodded slightly, his remnant soul fading gradually, leaving behind only one profound words: 「You have this patience... good.」"

choices.description: "Chen Ji decided before taking action to extract more information from Mo Xiansheng. He had no intention of being a chess piece without any knowledge."
choices.visible_reward: "Gain key information: Weakness of the Eyes of Heavenly Way"

text.content: "「Before I make my decision,」 Chen Ji's gaze flickered slightly, 「I need to know more. For instance—what is the weakness of the Eyes of Heavenly Way? What exactly did Chen Xuan discover back then? Why has Ling Yuan survived until now?」 Mo Xiansheng fell silent for a moment, his remnant shadow solidifying somewhat: 「You ask well. But some answers, you must seek yourself. I can only tell you one thing—」 His voice dropped abruptly low. 「Chen Xuan's death was no accident.」"

"Night deepened, the faint glow of the Tianji Record swirling in Chen Ji's palm. He slowly opened the final page of the fourth layer—there was only a single line of text, yet it made him freeze entirely. That line was written in blood, emanating an ancient and eerie aura: 'The chess game of fate is changing—and you, are already within it.' Chen Ji stared at that line for a long time, finally revealing a profound smile. Is that so? Then let it change faster."

"Outside the cave dwelling, the night wind carried an unsettling scent. Chen Ji knew Ling Yuan's gaze was only the beginning. The moment he set foot on this path, he was destined to become enemies with the Eyes of Heavenly Way. But he did not fear—because he was no longer the helpless waste he once was. He was the master of the Tianji Record, the one who would overturn the board. Beyond the window, on the distant Tianqing Peak, a barely perceptible flash of light flickered past. Chen Ji narrowed his eyes, a cold smile curling his lips. Come then, let me see what other tricks you have."

"The unsealing of the fourth layer of the Tianji Record granted Chen Ji unprecedented power and revealed an even more terrifying truth. But none of this made him retreat. On the contrary, when the truth surfaced, the fire in his heart burned even fiercer. From waste disciple to master of heavenly secrets, from manipulated chess piece to one who overturns the game—Chen Ji's path is still long. And now, a new page has only begun to turn."

"Ling Yuan's warning hung like a sword over his head, ready to fall at any moment. Yet Chen Ji knew, given the other's temperament, he would not give him much breathing room. But he also understood—a true strong one never bows before threats. He rose, walked to the window, gazing at the stars barely visible in the night sky. The Eyes of Heavenly Way watches him, so what? He would let those eyes know—the piece it selected will ultimately devour the entire game. The chess game of fate is changing, and you, are already within it."
